library.description: Store-neutral capability lifecycle and feature gate.

blocks.text: English
让功能开关管住功能本身：开关关掉时，功能已经启动的连接、计时器和订阅随之释放；功能之间有依赖时，按依赖启动、回滚和关闭。

items: 配置中心已经关掉了功能，它建立的连接和计时器还在跑。 开关只在启动前判断了一次，之后没人负责关掉它创建的资源。运行示例
推送了一份新配置，要自己和旧配置逐项比对。 漏掉一项，就有一个本该关闭的功能留在后台。运行示例
页面两个位置同时打开同一项功能，建立了两条连接。 第一次启动还没完成，第二个调用方看不到它，又启动了一次。运行示例
管理员已经关掉功能，慢一步完成的加载又把它打开了。 异步启动的结果回来时，没人检查开关是否已经变了。运行示例
功能之间有依赖，启动和关闭的顺序却靠手写。 页面比它依赖的服务先启动；或者某一步启动失败，前面已经启动的服务留在后台。运行示例

blocks.text: 常见做法是从配置中心或功能开关服务拿到一组布尔值，在代码里写 `if (flags.chat) startChat()`。开关服务只告诉你值是多少，不管值变了以后，功能已经启动的连接、计时器和订阅怎么办。本包把每个功能变成一个由宿主持有的生命周期：开关决定能不能运行，宿主负责启动、停止和清理。

items: 关掉开关，功能真的停下。 常见做法里，开关变成 false 只影响以后的判断，已经运行的功能照常工作。这里 `setFlag(name, false)` 会立即撤下功能并调用它的 `dispose`，连接断开，计时器停止。运行示例
整份配置一次替换，没列出的功能自动释放。 不用自己比对新旧配置。`setFlags` 原子替换全部开关，没有出现在新配置里的功能视为关闭，并按启动完成的相反顺序释放。运行示例
同时打开只启动一次。 只检查“是否已经有实例”会漏掉启动还没完成的那段时间。这里并发的 `enable` 共享同一次启动和同一个 Promise。运行示例
关掉之后，晚到的启动不会把功能复活。 异步启动完成时如果开关已经关闭，宿主丢弃这个结果，并释放它刚创建的资源。运行示例
依赖决定启动、回滚和关闭的顺序。 用依赖图登记功能之间的依赖后，提供服务的一方先启动、后关闭；某一步启动失败时，已经启动的部分按相反顺序回滚。启动顺序、失败回滚

blocks.text: “句柄”是启用后交回的业务对象，dispose 负责收尾；“世代”区分仍有效和已经作废的异步工作；“提供方”是服务来源，“消费方”使用它；“required”是缺失就不能启动的硬依赖；“DAG”是没有循环的有向依赖图；“拓扑顺序”保证提供方在消费方前面。能力图管理服务资源，不计算响应式数据。

blocks.text: 运行时依赖 @migaia/lifecycle 和 @migaia/utils；没有 Store、DOM 或 Node 专属后端依赖。

blocks.text: 根入口 @migaia/capability 提供 Capability Host、状态常量、错误身份和 readiness 快照。四个独立子入口分别是 @migaia/capability/graph（静态生命周期图）、@migaia/capability/graph/topology（纯拓扑与增量索引）、@migaia/capability/graph/dependency（纯依赖计划）和 @migaia/capability/graph/dynamic（运行时变更与 binding 所有权）。从实际入口导入，不把内部文件当公开路径。
本包依赖 @migaia/lifecycle 的世代、所有权、排空和队列原语，以及 @migaia/utils 的错误与 thenable 工具；不反向依赖 Store、UI、DOM、Node 或平台适配层。默认静态 Graph 需要宿主提供原生 AbortController/AbortSignal，只有 ESM 支持并不足够。
本文的 Host 始终指 createCapabilityHost 创建的进程内功能容器。它保存定义、共享 context、开关与启停状态，不读取 provider → consumer 依赖边。PluginHost 负责插件安装、管线与回滚；Storage Host 组合存储后端；Worker、线程或进程的运行域管理负责隔离与物理终止，均不等于这里的 Host。
能力图描述资源和服务的启动依赖，不是响应式数据的计算依赖图。静态 Graph 只接受硬依赖；optional provider 缺席仍运行、变化通知和跨运行域适配并非该入口的功能。动态拓扑使用独立 dynamic 入口。当前包不发布跨运行域 adapter，Promise 超时不能终止同一运行域里的同步死循环。
createCapabilityHost(context, options?) 返回 `ICapabilityHost<Context>`；Context 由实参推导。context 是交给全部 activate 的同一个引用，不会被冻结、读取或修改。调用方只放能力确实需要的应用数据。

options 默认空对象，必须是对象或函数，null/原始值触发带 INVALID_OPTION 的 TypeError。options.flags 与 options.onError 在创建时取得快照，后续改写原对象不改变行为。flags 省略时全部拒绝；onError 省略时没有用户诊断回调，提供时必须可调用。读取 options 字段失败以 INVALID_OPTION 保留原 cause；onError 的方法接收者保留为原 options 对象。
flags 只接受自有、可枚举、值严格为 true 的数据属性。继承属性不算允许，getter 不会被求值；`__proto__` 与 constructor 只是内部 Map 的普通键。原 flags 后续变化无效，必须调用 setFlag 或 setFlags。读取属性描述符失败会保留精确原因。

ICapabilityHandle 的唯一约束是 dispose(): void 或 `PromiseLike<void>`；业务方法由具体能力扩展，Host 不包装业务对象。`ICapabilityDefinition<Context, Handle>` 要求 name 和 activate(context)，Handle 默认 ICapabilityHandle。name 必须是 trim 后非空字符串；重复名字、无效名字和不可调用 activate 分别为 ALREADY_REGISTERED、INVALID_NAME、INVALID_ACTIVATE。
register 在登记时读取并冻结 name/activate 快照。后续改原定义不会改已登记身份；方法形式的 activate 可读取冻结接收者上的 this.name。成功激活时，Host 还会捕获 handle.dispose，之后修改该属性不能替换释放责任。缺少可调用 dispose 或读取它失败是 INVALID_HANDLE 的 TypeError，能力进入 failed。

rows: 同步登记，不激活；Host 终态或重入窗口内拒绝。
每次返回当前登记名字的数组副本。
返回该能力的状态；未登记抛 NOT_REGISTERED。
返回 activate 创建的同一个业务句柄；未启用返回 undefined，未登记抛 NOT_REGISTERED。
返回当前代最近一次激活或释放失败；重启成功或重新配置后清空。
只有严格 true 放行；false 同步作废在途激活、撤下已有句柄并开始释放；true 不自动激活。

首次整体关闭时即为 true；只读诊断继续可用，变更不能恢复该 Host。

blocks.text: 除上表各参数外没有隐藏选项。state/handle/error 的 name 必须已登记；setFlag 可先为之后登记的名字配置开关。enable/disable 对非法操作返回 rejected Promise；disable 先判断 HOST_DISPOSED，再判断名字。register/setFlag/setFlags 的准入错误同步抛出。
CapabilityState 与 ICapabilityState 的五个值为 off（允许但未启用）、gated（开关拒绝）、activating（正在激活）、on（持有有效句柄）、failed（激活失败）。释放失败记录 error 并上报，保持 off/gated，不把它们改成 failed。gated 与图的 blocked 不是同一状态。

CapabilityEnableStatus 的值为 enabled、gated、cancelled、failed。ICapabilityEnableResult 只有 failed 分支额外带 error；ICapabilityEnableStatusValue 是这些 status 的联合类型。enabled 表示结果已被采纳；初始拒绝或晚到结果完成时开关仍拒绝返回 gated；disable、dispose 或其它代际作废返回 cancelled；当前代激活抛错或句柄无效返回 failed，error 与 error(name) 一致。
每次作废会推进 lifecycle 世代。activate 晚到时只在发起世代仍有效的情况下采纳；否则立即释放新得到的句柄，不能把已关闭的能力重新打开。旧代清理失败仍会报告，但不会污染已经健康的新句柄；当前代或尚无替代实例的适用清理失败留在 error(name)。
批量 setFlags 回退与 dispose 都按真实激活完成顺序反向释放，不按登记顺序或 enable 调用顺序。单项清理失败不阻断其他项；Host 保存并报告失败，正常清理策略不另造聚合拒绝。disable 只排空指定能力，dispose 排空全部能力；等待期间新增的晚到清理也包含在内。永不完成的 activate/释放会让相应排空等待持续进行。
首次 dispose 返回唯一 completion Promise。它完成前，后续 dispose 以 HOST_TRANSITIONING 拒绝；同步 disposer 重入会同步抛出，栈后重入返回 rejected Promise。首次完成后才返回同一个 canonical Promise。保留并等待首次结果，不用再次 dispose 加入正在进行的关闭。

disposer/reporter 的同步转换窗口不允许同一 Host 的变更重入。register/setFlag/setFlags 同步抛 HOST_TRANSITIONING；enable/disable 返回拒绝的 Promise。onError(name, error) 观察激活、释放和异常 thenable 失败；它自己的 throw/rejection 交给 utils 的共享宿主异常队列，不改变开关状态或覆盖业务错误。

Host 没有 dependsOn，也不强制串行所有 activate。若 A 必须先于 B 启用，应先 await enable(A)，或使用静态 Graph。把动态 import() 的调用放进 activate，加载才跟随许可后的激活；是否拆包由构建器决定，静态 import 的体积不会因开关消失。多租户应各建一个 Host 和开关快照。旧 enableResult、enableLegacyBoolean、disableNow 已移除；需要布尔值时比较 enable 结果的 status，物理清理则等待 disable。

sections.heading: 静态 Graph：登记、启动与读取

blocks.text: createCapabilityGraph(options?) 的 options 默认空对象，仅有可选 onError，缺省无用户诊断回调。它在创建 lifecycle 根 scope 前读取并验证回调，getter 或不可调用值为 GRAPH_INVALID_OPTION。

IGraphNodeId 是带品牌的字符串类型。`IGraphNodeDefinition<T>` 的必填字段为 id、kind、dependencies、start；id/kind 为非空字符串，dependencies 为数组，边必须含 provider 和 required: true。start(context) 返回或异步返回 { value, release }，release 必须可调用，value 可以合法地为 undefined。静态注册读取并保存字段与冻结边快照；重复节点/边分别拒绝。所有定义在首次 ready 前登记，ready 后 GRAPH_FROZEN；关闭接纳时 GRAPH_ADMISSION_CLOSED，终态 GRAPH_DISPOSED。
ready 先检查缺失 provider、自环与依赖环，再按 level、ordinal 分层调用 start。同层按登记序号发起，并行等待整层全部 settle，整层成功才进下一层。失败以该层规范顺序首个失败为 primary，其余失败保留于 errors 链，再回滚本层成功节点和此前已启动节点。启动失败不隐式重试，但仍可 dispose 收尾。

IGraphStartContext 提供 nodeId、原生 signal、get(provider)、own(resource, descriptor)。get 只允许已声明且 ready 的直接 provider，不取得 lease；启动上下文结束、作废或关闭后不能继续调用。own 将辅助资源交给 provisional scope，失败、取消、作废或关闭时回滚；descriptor 必须立即有可调用 force，错误为 GRAPH_INVALID_OPTION，原 lifecycle TypeError 经 cause 可达。不能把同一个 primary value 再作为辅助资源重复拥有。
primary value/release 只由 Graph 拥有一次，节点内先释放 primary 再释放 auxiliary，节点间逆拓扑释放。primary release(context) 收到结构化 signal、nodeId 和 report；清理失败走 Graph 的错误与诊断策略。

rows: 只在 open 时登记定义。
启动一次；重复调用保留同一 Promise，启动失败不自动 retry。
冻结的登记 id 数组，终态仍可查询。
冻结的时间点诊断，含 id、kind、state、value、error；未知 id 为 GRAPH_UNKNOWN_NODE。
直接读取同一原 payload，不创建诊断投影；仅整图 ready 时可见，其他时点为 undefined，未知 id 仍抛错。
校验 consumer 已声明该直接依赖且 provider ready；不等于任意节点查询。
整图状态与保留的 primary 错误。
先关闭接纳、取消启动，再逆拓扑释放；重复调用返回同一 Promise。

blocks.text: 整图状态为 open、starting、ready、failed、quiescing、terminal。节点状态为 registered、starting、ready、suspended、failed、blocked、rolled-back、released；静态入口不提供动态 suspend 方法。readValue 的 undefined 也可能是真实数据，需结合 graph.state 判断可用性；payload 保持原对象身份和可变性，旧诊断不随之变成新的状态快照。自写 ICapabilityGraph 实现必须包含 readValue。
同步生命周期回调重入同一 Graph 操作触发 GRAPH_REENTRANT_OPERATION。onError 观察 cleanup 和 late-result failure，不替换 primary；回调自身失败也交给共享宿主异常队列。Graph dispose 的失败可返回 GRAPH_DISPOSE_FAILED，和 Host 报告后继续完成的策略不同。
静态建图只读取一次节点和边，以迭代 DFS 和 ordinal/level 桶在线性 O(v + e + p) 成本内构造，p 为捕获输入大小。多闭环按根 ordinal 与声明依赖顺序报告遇到的首个闭环。动态增删保留原算法。

buildCapabilityTopology(nodes, onUnknownProvider, onCycle, onInvalid) 只计算，不调用 start 或 release。四个参数均必填。节点为 { id, dependencies, ordinal }；ordinal 必须是唯一安全整数，连续覆盖 [0, nodeCount)，不静默重排或重写坏输入。边的 provider 非空、required 为 boolean；缺席 required provider 交 onUnknownProvider(nodeId, provider)，存在的 optional 边也参与层级和环检测。

结果 ICapabilityTopology 深冻结，包含 ordered，以及只读 providers、consumers、indegree、level、ordinal 映射。顺序为 (level, ordinal)：先依赖层级，同层再登记顺序。providers 为提供者到消费者，consumers 为消费者到依赖；indegree 是接纳时的依赖数。ReadonlyMap/ReadonlySet facade 不提供 mutation；forEach(callback, thisArg?) 保留标准接收者语义。

onCycle(path) 与 onInvalid(reason, nodeId?, failure?) 由调用方决定抛出错误外壳。getter 失败的 failure 含精确 cause，即使 cause 为 undefined 也保留；纯拓扑 owner 将其留在 adapter 抛出错误的 cause/errors 链，不换掉可附加的原生错误身份。TopologyInvalidReason 的值为 invalid-node、duplicate-node、duplicate-edge、duplicate-ordinal、unknown-node、transaction-open、transaction-closed。

createTopologyIndex(adapter) 要求 onCycle 与 onInvalid，不创建服务。增量输入只有 id/dependencies，索引自己持有单调 registrationOrdinal；删除不重编号，setDependencies 不更换登记序号。snapshot().ordinal 则把当前节点压缩为连续序号，供静态投影使用。required 与当前存在的 optional 边参与层级与环检测，缺席 optional provider 被记录但不阻塞节点。

rows: 当前节点数与是否存在。
读取原单调登记序号，未知节点由 onInvalid 处理。
原子更新节点或边，保留缺席 provider 的悬空事实。
冻结的直接边，或按 required/optional 分类的直接消费者。
当前缺席 provider 的边。
包含 roots 的 required 消费者传递闭包，按规范顺序返回。
全部或给定子集的规范顺序；省略即全部，子集去重，未知 id 拒绝。
深冻结的静态拓扑投影。
隔离事务，提供同一套 reader/writer 和 commit/rollback。

blocks.text: 事务提交前基础读保持原快照，基础写和嵌套 begin 被拒绝。commit 发布工作副本，rollback 丢弃它并保留全部可观察事实；完成后的事务连读取都拒绝。静态拓扑与增量索引复用同一私有结构/边准入，不公开可信构建助手。

dependency 入口不启动、释放或修改索引。IDependencyStateReader 返回 activated、enabled、suspended、stale 四个独立 boolean：是否已激活、是否允许、是否挂起、保留绑定是否过期；没有一个合并的状态字符串。计划深冻结，含 steps（id/action）、order、edges（provider/consumer/optional/status?）和 blockedBy。

DependencyPolicy 为 reject、cascade、suspend；DependencyMutationKind 为 remove、disable。DependencyAction 为 release、disable、suspend、resume、rebind、restart、activate、invalidate。DependencyEdgeStatus.optionalAbsent 的值是 optional-absent，说明缺席的可选 provider。

rows: request 必含 roots、kind、policy；reject 报告阻塞者，cascade 生成消费者优先计划，suspend 只暂停已激活且未挂起的消费者。remove 的根动作为 release，disable 为 disable。
消费者优先重启闭包，跳过未激活节点；已挂起节点改为 invalidate。
request 含 target、canRebind；先安排直接 rebind，挂起消费者 invalidate，其余生成 restart 闭包。
request 含 provider、generationChanged、canRebind；只遍历挂起前沿，过期者 restart，仍缺 required provider 者继续阻塞。
仅规划尚未激活的 required 上游 provider，不把 roots 本身放进 activate steps。
选择批次内非 lazy 成员及其 required provider，返回规范顺序的只读 Set。
规划全部节点的逆规范释放顺序。
投影受影响集合的 required 内部边与相关 optional 边。

blocks.text: invalidate 表示现有挂起实例的绑定已过期，调用方保持挂起并置 stale；之后由 planResume 选择 restart。canRebind 是调用方的能力判断，不是规划器执行 rebind。执行、错误上报、世代、lease 和物理清理仍归组合 owner。非法 mutation kind/policy 触发 GRAPH_INVALID_OPTION。

sections.id: 动态-graph-与精确代际所有权
sections.heading: 动态 Graph 与精确代际所有权

blocks.text: createDynamicCapabilityGraph(options) 必须提供 startBatch(entries) 与 releaseBatch(entries, fence)，缺少任何一个都为 GRAPH_INVALID_OPTION。没有默认节点级执行宿主；组合 owner 决定怎样启动 definition.start、建立值与释放 instance。start entries 含 id、binding、冻结定义；release entries 含 id、binding、instance，均对应精确旧实例，按提供方优先的规范顺序交付；owner 等待 fence 后自行倒序执行物理释放。

可选 report 默认无用户回调；mutationAdmissionMs 默认 undefined，队列预算实际关闭，提供时必须为非负有限数；releaseBinding 默认不调用。普通 mutation 共用 FIFO，拒绝的前序任务不阻塞后来者。排队超过 admission 预算、尚未执行的任务以 GRAPH_MUTATION_ADMISSION_TIMEOUT 拒绝并保留 lifecycle 原错。最终 dispose 在同一 FIFO 等待已准入任务，但关闭自身 admission timeout，不强制中断前序工作。

register(node, binding?) 和 replace(node, binding?, options?) 在离开队列、开始执行时才读取 id/kind/start/dependencies，一次接纳为不可变定义与边快照。改原对象不改变身份、诊断或边；更改定义必须 replace。捕获的 start 保留原 definition 接收者与返回值，getter 失败为 GRAPH_INVALID_NODE，原错误或 cause 保留。binding 省略为 undefined；没有绑定时不能 acquireBinding。

rows: 允许 required/optional 边，登记后尝试启动受影响前沿；缺席 optional 不阻塞。
policy 默认 cascade；移除目标定义，释放受影响实例，仍保留的消费者因 removed 阻塞；reject 有 required 消费者时原子拒绝。
同样只接受 reject/cascade，默认 cascade；保留实例，不执行 release，依赖消费者被阻塞。
目标必须 suspended，否则 GRAPH_NODE_NOT_SUSPENDED；恢复满足全部 required provider 的前沿，已有实例不重新 start。
restartDependents 默认启用；false 时用 onReplaced 通知直接 required 消费者，缺少回调或回调失败则重启相应闭包；失败先 report。
返回 required/optional 两组直接消费者，未知 id 抛 GRAPH_UNKNOWN_NODE。
尝试启动当前 registered/blocked/failed 前沿，再将整图标记 ready，不冻结拓扑；仍可能保留 blocked 节点，不保证重复调用同一 Promise。
返回新的、未冻结的 id/kind/state/value/error/reason/binding/generation/ordinal/rank/level 诊断记录。
非 owning 读取，不检查节点可用性；未知 id 或缺席绑定返回 undefined，不能据此持有异步使用权。
仅 ready 且存在 binding 时返回冻结 { value, release }；release 幂等。
当前登记 id、整图状态与变更世代。
关闭接纳，按规范释放路径收尾并清空定义，重复调用同 Promise。

blocks.text: 动态 remove/suspend 不接受纯规划器的 suspend 策略。默认 cascade 不删除所有消费者定义，而是按影响关闭/阻塞它们。optional 边不触发 required 级联，dependentsOf 仍会报告这些直接关系。顺序始终按 level/ordinal，不采用不同层级之间仅按最小 ordinal 的旧顺序。

每个变更结果只有 affected、topologyChanged、generation，没有公开测试计数或计时字段。同边 replace 保留 ordinal/rank/level 的语义；改变边后重新计算诊断。GraphBlockedReason 的 missing、suspended、removed、failed 从 graph 入口导入；GraphBindingReleaseReason 的 remove、replace、dispose 从 dynamic 入口导入；readiness 的 ready/blocked/failed 使用根入口 GraphReadinessState。

异步工作要在 acquireBinding 后用 finally 调用 lease.release。remove/replace/dispose 先 seal 旧 generation，把同一个不会 reject 的 fence 交给 releaseBatch；所有精确旧 lease 归零后 fence 才 resolve。组合 owner 不得在 fence 前启动物理 disposer。新 generation 使用不同 lease key，晚到旧 release 不会替新绑定解锁；releaseBinding 在所属实例清理后按 remove/replace/dispose 原因交回 binding custody。

startBatch 单节点失败能归给该节点 failed；多节点批次无法归因时全部 blocked，reason 为 failed。nodeState.error 保留原始错误，GRAPH_START_FAILED 的 detail.nodes 列出整批节点。startBatch 部分启动成功后抛错时，Graph 不知道已创建的部分实例，组合 owner 必须回滚；静态 Graph 的整层回滚保证不能套用到这里。report 是最终观察口，自己的 throw/rejection 不改变 mutation 结果，交共享宿主异常队列。
snapshotGraphReadiness(source) 是桥接外部 readiness source 的低层工具。严格先读 state，再读 error，各一次；只接受 GraphReadinessState.ready/blocked/failed，返回冻结 { state, error }。普通代码读取 Graph 本身状态即可，不应把这三个可用性值当 Host 的五个生命周期状态。
原生且可附码的 getter Error 保持实例、类型和 stack，并附 INVALID_OPTION；primitive、不可变错误或冲突身份走 coded fallback，原值仍在 cause（包含抛出 undefined）。state 非法时立即拒绝，不继续读取 error。

Host 自有错误的 source 为 CAPABILITY_SOURCE，即 capability；Graph 自有错误为 CAPABILITY_GRAPH_SOURCE，即 capability.graph。用 (source, code) 区分归属。身份字段通过属性附加，不改写 stack；可附加的原生错误保留类型与实例，需包装时经 cause/errors 保留原对象。私有错误工厂不是公开入口。

rows: 终态 Host 上调用变更方法。
同步生命周期重入，或首次 dispose 完成前再次调用。
查询或操作未登记能力。
名字不是 trim 后非空字符串，TypeError。
激活结果缺少可调用 dispose，TypeError。
保留诊断码，当前 enable 返回 gated 而不抛此码。
options/flags/definition/readiness 准入或读取失败，保留原 cause。

blocks.text: CapabilityErrorCode 与 ICapabilityErrorCode 是以上常量表与值联合。code 是公开 API，不另造别名。

rows: GRAPH_DISPOSED：终态变更或不允许的读取。
GRAPH_INVALID_NODE：定义、边或启动结果形状非法。
GRAPH_UNKNOWN_PROVIDER：静态 required provider 缺席。
GRAPH_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE：直接读取未声明/未 ready provider，或不能取得 binding lease。
GRAPH_START_FAILED：启动失败，回滚或记录失败批次。
GRAPH_ADMISSION_CLOSED：关闭中或已结束的启动 context 继续接纳工作。
GRAPH_REENTRANT_OPERATION：同步生命周期回调重入。
GRAPH_INVALID_OPTION：选项或 own descriptor 不合法。
GRAPH_NODE_HAS_DEPENDENTS：reject 策略遇到 required 消费者。
GRAPH_MUTATION_ADMISSION_TIMEOUT：尚未执行的普通变更排队超时。

blocks.text: 持久化或其他可选功能的组合顺序为：创建包含所需应用对象的 context；登记在 activate 内 await import 的功能；等待 enable 结果，只有 enabled 时读取业务 handle；离开页面等待 disable；应用退出等待首次 dispose。错误上报只观察，不能反向改变生命周期。多租户分别创建容器，不共享开关状态。
enable 返回 gated 时先检查是否修改了原 flags、值是否严格为 true、是否忘了 setFlag；setFlags({}) 会撤回全部权限，只改单项用 setFlag。关掉后又自行出现时检查是否绕过 Host 直接执行 activate 或在清理回调里重入。需要服务依赖启动顺序时使用 Graph，而不是让 Host 猜测。
本包提供 fmt、lint、typecheck、typecheck:test、test；构建使用 build。bench:resume 是仓库已有的规划测量入口，但本文不据此声明未核实的性能结论。
English · 返回 README
先选择当前事故对应的场景，再查 Host、Graph 与纯规划接口的边界。六个示例均通过公开入口调用，不需要外部服务或另造执行宿主。

rows: 把开关许可与实际启用分开
两个调用方等待时只激活一次
撤回许可后释放晚到的句柄
关掉开关时，已经运行的功能随之停止
用一份新配置替换全部开关，未列出的功能自动释放
先启动提供方，先释放消费方
消费方启动失败时回滚已启动的提供方
申请资源前先查看依赖启动顺序

sections.id: 把开关许可与实际启用分开
sections.heading: 把开关许可与实际启用分开

blocks.text: 当前租户还没有允许某项功能，功能却已下载或开始工作。
只在登记时检查一次布尔值，无法管理之后的激活和清理；把打开开关与执行启动混在一起，也可能在应用需要之前就开始工作。
创建一个能力宿主来持有激活状态和可释放句柄，并登记激活回调。缺失的开关默认拒绝激活，先用 `setFlag(name, true)` 授权，再调用 `enable(name)` 启动，最后用 `dispose()` 释放。
context 的 tenant: demo 是共享应用数据，Host 只将它原样交给 activate。第二参数省略，flags 默认全部拒绝，onError 默认没有回调。register 的 name 为 export，activate 返回带 dispose 的句柄；setFlag 的 true 只授权，enable 才真正启动。
输出：

blocks.code:
首次尝试: gated
授权后: off
启用: demo
启用结果: enabled
释放: export

blocks.text: 依次输出 `首次尝试: gated`、`授权后: off`、`启用: demo`、`启用结果: enabled`、`释放: export`。
被拒绝的尝试没有执行激活回调，单独授权仍让能力保持关闭。宿主不会撤销静态导入；若代码下载也要等许可，应把动态导入放在 `activate` 内。

sections.id: 两个调用方等待时只激活一次
sections.heading: 两个调用方等待时只激活一次

blocks.text: 页面两个位置同时启用同一项功能，第一次激活尚未完成，就建立了重复连接或工作线程。
只检查句柄是否已经存在，会漏掉第一次激活仍在等待的这段时间；两个调用方都看不到句柄，于是分别启动同一份工作。
在同一宿主上调用 `enable(name)`。它先登记在途 Promise，再调用激活回调，期间到来的第二次调用会加入同一个 Promise，收到同一次分类结果。
本例 context 为 undefined，options.flags.search 为 true，onError 省略。异步 activate 返回带 dispose 的句柄；name 在 register 与两次 enable 中都是 search。共享保证只针对同一 Host 上仍在等待的那次激活。
输出：

blocks.code:
同一 Promise: true
结果: enabled,enabled
激活次数: 1

blocks.text: 依次输出 `同一 Promise: true`、`结果: enabled,enabled`、`激活次数: 1`。
并发调用共享的是同一次在途激活，而不只是两个相同的状态值。能力已经启用后再调用，不保证返回同一个 Promise；不同宿主也不共享激活状态。

sections.id: 撤回许可后释放晚到的句柄
sections.heading: 撤回许可后释放晚到的句柄

blocks.text: 异步激活尚未结束，管理员已经关闭功能，旧请求完成后功能却又重新启用了。
只在第一个 `await` 前检查开关，只能决定是否开始工作；返回后无条件保存句柄，会让过期的完成结果恢复已经撤销许可的能力。
用 `setFlag(name, false)` 撤回许可，宿主立即作废这次激活。句柄之后到达时会被释放，不会被接纳；需要等待全部激活及清理结束时，再等待 `dispose()`。
flags.export 初始为 true，activate 返回本例手动完成的 Promise。setFlag 的 false 撤销许可，finish 交付一个带 dispose 的句柄。因为结束时许可仍为 false，结果是 gated；如果由 disable 作废而许可仍允许，则结果为 cancelled。
输出：

blocks.code:
释放晚到句柄
启用结果: gated
状态: gated
已接纳句柄: false

blocks.text: 依次输出 `释放晚到句柄`、`启用结果: gated`、`状态: gated`、`已接纳句柄: false`。
许可仍被撤回时，旧结果不能成为启用句柄。宿主不会强行打断用户的激活代码，而是在它结束时接管返回句柄。开关更新后异步释放可能仍在继续，需要等待 `disable()` 或 `dispose()` 才能排空。

sections.id: 关掉开关时-已经运行的功能随之停止
sections.heading: 关掉开关时，已经运行的功能随之停止

blocks.text: 在线客服功能已经为当前租户建立了连接，并每秒发送一次心跳。运营在配置中心把它关掉了。
常见做法是从配置中心或功能开关服务拿到一组布尔值，在代码里写 `if (flags.liveChat) startChat()`。开关服务只告诉你值是多少，不管值变了以后怎么办：判断只在启动前做一次，开关关掉后，已经建立的连接和计时器照常运行，除非你在每个功能里自己监听开关变化、自己找到并关闭它创建的资源。
在宿主里，功能启动时返回的句柄由宿主持有。`setFlag(name, false)` 会同步撤下这个句柄并调用它的 `dispose`，功能真正停下来；`disable(name)` 等待释放完成。
context 的 tenant 为 acme，会原样交给 activate。options.flags.liveChat 初始为 true。activate 建立连接并启动心跳计时器，返回的句柄负责停止计时器并断开连接。
输出：

blocks.code:
连接客服: acme
启用结果: enabled
断开客服
状态: gated 句柄: undefined
释放完成

blocks.text: 依次输出 `连接客服: acme`、`启用结果: enabled`、`断开客服`、`状态: gated 句柄: undefined`、`释放完成`。关掉开关的同时，句柄的 `dispose` 已经执行，计时器停止，进程也随之正常退出，没有遗留的心跳。
关掉开关只负责停下功能，重新打开时不会自动启动，需要再调用 `enable(name)`。`dispose` 是异步时，释放会在后台继续，需要确认资源已经回收时等待 `disable(name)` 或 `dispose()`。

sections.id: 用一份新配置替换全部开关-未列出的功能自动释放
sections.heading: 用一份新配置替换全部开关，未列出的功能自动释放

blocks.text: 应用启动后打开了搜索、客服和导出三项功能。配置中心推送了一份新配置：保留搜索，关闭客服，导出没有出现在新配置里。
常见做法拿到新配置后，要自己和旧配置逐项比较，找出哪些功能被关掉、哪些被删掉，再逐个调用各自的停止函数；漏掉一项，它就继续运行。停止的顺序通常是代码里写的顺序，后启动、可能依赖先启动功能的那个，反而可能先被留下或后被关闭。
`setFlags(flags)` 用一整份新配置原子替换全部开关。没有出现在新配置里的名字一律视为关闭；被关闭的功能按实际启动完成的相反顺序释放。
options.flags 初始允许三项功能。三项按搜索、客服、导出的顺序启动。新配置只列出 search: true 和 chat: false，export 没有列出。
输出：

blocks.code:
启动 search
启动 chat
启动 export
停止 export
停止 chat
search=on export=gated chat=gated
停止 search

blocks.text: 依次输出三次启动，然后是 `停止 export`、`停止 chat`、`search=on export=gated chat=gated`，最后 `dispose()` 输出 `停止 search`。导出没有出现在新配置里，和明确关闭的客服一样被释放；释放顺序与启动完成顺序相反。
新配置是整份替换，不是合并：想保留的功能必须写进新配置。替换只负责关闭和释放，新允许的功能仍要调用 `enable(name)` 才会启动。多租户应各建一个宿主，各自持有自己的开关快照。

sections.id: 先启动提供方-先释放消费方
sections.heading: 先启动提供方，先释放消费方

blocks.text: 页面在配置服务就绪前启动，或者清理时配置已经关闭，页面却仍在使用它。
按登记顺序执行启动回调，会让正确性依赖哪个模块先登记；异步回调的完成顺序也不能可靠地代表依赖关系，直接把它倒过来清理仍可能出错。
在静态能力图中登记明确的必需提供方依赖，再等待 `ready()`。启动回调用 `context.get()` 读取已声明且就绪的提供方，图持有返回实例，并在释放时按拓扑逆序清理。
两个节点都填写 id、kind、dependencies、start。页面先登记，但其 required: true 边明确要求 config；配置无依赖。start 返回 value/release，页面通过 context.get 读取直接 provider 的 theme。options 省略，onError 默认没有用户回调。
输出：

blocks.code:
启动配置
启动页面: dark
状态: ready
释放页面
释放配置

blocks.text: 依次输出 `启动配置`、`启动页面: dark`、`状态: ready`、`释放页面`、`释放配置`。
虽然消费方先登记，提供方仍先启动、后释放。这是资源依赖图，不是响应式数据图。首次 `ready()` 会冻结登记，需要在启动后增删定义时应选择动态图入口。

sections.id: 消费方启动失败时回滚已启动的提供方
sections.heading: 消费方启动失败时回滚已启动的提供方

blocks.text: 服务已经成功启动，依赖它的页面却启动失败，整个功能没有就绪，服务仍留在后台运行。
手写顺序启动通常在某个 `await` 抛错后直接退出；之前创建的资源不会自动释放，必须在每条失败路径补清理，还要避免清理错误覆盖启动主错误。
等待图的 `ready()` 并捕获失败。图会等待当前启动层结束，回滚已经持有的资源，并保留原始启动失败供诊断。
消费方的 required: true 边仍指向配置；start 抛出本例创建的 primary 错误来展示失败路径。提供方已返回的 value/release 由图持有，ready 拒绝前会回滚。代码没有为该失败创建另一套资源所有者。
输出：

blocks.code:
回滚配置
保留原错: true
错误码: GRAPH_START_FAILED
提供方: rolled-back
图状态: failed

blocks.text: 依次输出 `回滚配置`、`保留原错: true`、`错误码: GRAPH_START_FAILED`、`提供方: rolled-back`、`图状态: failed`。
提供方在就绪结果拒绝前已释放。这个普通可扩展 Error 被附加标识后仍是原对象；已有其他来源或不可扩展的错误可能被包装，原错仍在原因链上。失败的静态图不会隐式重试。

sections.id: 申请资源前先查看依赖启动顺序
sections.heading: 申请资源前先查看依赖启动顺序

blocks.text: 配置编辑器需要先预览提供方顺序和依赖深度，再决定是否启动服务。
只按登记顺序排序可能把消费方排在前面；为了看顺序就启动一张运行图，又会把校验规划和资源申请混在一起。
向 `buildCapabilityTopology()` 传入节点标识、依赖边和连续登记序号，并提供三个由调用方决定错误形式的失败回调。它返回冻结拓扑快照，提供计划顺序与层级，不执行资源启动或释放。
nodes 中 id 是非空字符串，ordinal 唯一覆盖 0、1、2；dependencies 的 provider 指向 config，required 为 true。其余节点是空依赖数组。三个必填错误回调分别接收缺失 provider、环路径或结构错误；本例共用只抛出预先创建错误的 reject，正常输入不会调用它。
输出：

blocks.code:
输入顺序: screen,config,health
计划顺序: config,health,screen
层级: 0 0 1
冻结: true

blocks.text: 依次输出 `输入顺序: screen,config,health`、`计划顺序: config,health,screen`、`层级: 0 0 1`、`冻结: true`。
计划先排列提供方，同层按登记序号排序，且没有改变输入数组。登记序号必须唯一覆盖 0 至节点数减一。这个 API 只负责规划，需要持有资源启停时使用 `createCapabilityGraph()`。

根入口 @migaia/capability 提供 Capability Host、状态常量、错误身份和 readiness 快照。四个独立子入口分别是 @migaia/capability/graph（静态生命周期图）、@migaia/capability/graph/topology（纯拓扑与增量索引）、@migaia/capability/graph/dependency（纯依赖计划）和 @migaia/capability/graph/dynamic（运行时变更与 binding 所有权）。从实际入口导入，不把内部文件当公开路径。
本包依赖 @migaia/lifecycle 的世代、所有权、排空和队列原语，以及 @migaia/utils 的错误与 thenable 工具；不反向依赖 Store、UI、DOM、Node 或平台适配层。默认静态 Graph 需要宿主提供原生 AbortController/AbortSignal，只有 ESM 支持并不足够。
本文的 Host 始终指 createCapabilityHost 创建的进程内功能容器。它保存定义、共享 context、开关与启停状态，不读取 provider → consumer 依赖边。PluginHost 负责插件安装、管线与回滚；Storage Host 组合存储后端；Worker、线程或进程的运行域管理负责隔离与物理终止，均不等于这里的 Host。
能力图描述资源和服务的启动依赖，不是响应式数据的计算依赖图。静态 Graph 只接受硬依赖；optional provider 缺席仍运行、变化通知和跨运行域适配并非该入口的功能。动态拓扑使用独立 dynamic 入口。当前包不发布跨运行域 adapter，Promise 超时不能终止同一运行域里的同步死循环。
createCapabilityHost(context, options?) 返回 `ICapabilityHost<Context>`；Context 由实参推导。context 是交给全部 activate 的同一个引用，不会被冻结、读取或修改。调用方只放能力确实需要的应用数据。

options 默认空对象，必须是对象或函数，null/原始值触发带 INVALID_OPTION 的 TypeError。options.flags 与 options.onError 在创建时取得快照，后续改写原对象不改变行为。flags 省略时全部拒绝；onError 省略时没有用户诊断回调，提供时必须可调用。读取 options 字段失败以 INVALID_OPTION 保留原 cause；onError 的方法接收者保留为原 options 对象。
flags 只接受自有、可枚举、值严格为 true 的数据属性。继承属性不算允许，getter 不会被求值；`__proto__` 与 constructor 只是内部 Map 的普通键。原 flags 后续变化无效，必须调用 setFlag 或 setFlags。读取属性描述符失败会保留精确原因。

ICapabilityHandle 的唯一约束是 dispose(): void 或 `PromiseLike<void>`；业务方法由具体能力扩展，Host 不包装业务对象。`ICapabilityDefinition<Context, Handle>` 要求 name 和 activate(context)，Handle 默认 ICapabilityHandle。name 必须是 trim 后非空字符串；重复名字、无效名字和不可调用 activate 分别为 ALREADY_REGISTERED、INVALID_NAME、INVALID_ACTIVATE。
register 在登记时读取并冻结 name/activate 快照。后续改原定义不会改已登记身份；方法形式的 activate 可读取冻结接收者上的 this.name。成功激活时，Host 还会捕获 handle.dispose，之后修改该属性不能替换释放责任。缺少可调用 dispose 或读取它失败是 INVALID_HANDLE 的 TypeError，能力进入 failed。

rows: 同步登记，不激活；Host 终态或重入窗口内拒绝。
每次返回当前登记名字的数组副本。
返回该能力的状态；未登记抛 NOT_REGISTERED。
返回 activate 创建的同一个业务句柄；未启用返回 undefined，未登记抛 NOT_REGISTERED。
返回当前代最近一次激活或释放失败；重启成功或重新配置后清空。
只有严格 true 放行；false 同步作废在途激活、撤下已有句柄并开始释放；true 不自动激活。
原子替换整份允许表，遗漏名字即拒绝；读取失败先全部拒绝，再抛 INVALID_OPTION。
返回结构化结果；并发调用共享同一次激活及其 pending Promise，已 on 不再激活，拒绝状态不调用 activate。
等待该能力全部在途激活和释放排空；此前为 on 返回 true，activating 时会取消并等清理但返回 false。
终态关闭，按实际激活完成顺序反向释放并等待全部在途工作。
首次整体关闭时即为 true；只读诊断继续可用，变更不能恢复该 Host。

blocks.text: 除上表各参数外没有隐藏选项。state/handle/error 的 name 必须已登记；setFlag 可先为之后登记的名字配置开关。enable/disable 对非法操作返回 rejected Promise；disable 先判断 HOST_DISPOSED，再判断名字。register/setFlag/setFlags 的准入错误同步抛出。
CapabilityState 与 ICapabilityState 的五个值为 off（允许但未启用）、gated（开关拒绝）、activating（正在激活）、on（持有有效句柄）、failed（激活失败）。释放失败记录 error 并上报，保持 off/gated，不把它们改成 failed。gated 与图的 blocked 不是同一状态。

CapabilityEnableStatus 的值为 enabled、gated、cancelled、failed。ICapabilityEnableResult 只有 failed 分支额外带 error；ICapabilityEnableStatusValue 是这些 status 的联合类型。enabled 表示结果已被采纳；初始拒绝或晚到结果完成时开关仍拒绝返回 gated；disable、dispose 或其它代际作废返回 cancelled；当前代激活抛错或句柄无效返回 failed，error 与 error(name) 一致。
每次作废会推进 lifecycle 世代。activate 晚到时只在发起世代仍有效的情况下采纳；否则立即释放新得到的句柄，不能把已关闭的能力重新打开。旧代清理失败仍会报告，但不会污染已经健康的新句柄；当前代或尚无替代实例的适用清理失败留在 error(name)。
批量 setFlags 回退与 dispose 都按真实激活完成顺序反向释放，不按登记顺序或 enable 调用顺序。单项清理失败不阻断其他项；Host 保存并报告失败，正常清理策略不另造聚合拒绝。disable 只排空指定能力，dispose 排空全部能力；等待期间新增的晚到清理也包含在内。永不完成的 activate/释放会让相应排空等待持续进行。
首次 dispose 返回唯一 completion Promise。它完成前，后续 dispose 以 HOST_TRANSITIONING 拒绝；同步 disposer 重入会同步抛出，栈后重入返回 rejected Promise。首次完成后才返回同一个 canonical Promise。保留并等待首次结果，不用再次 dispose 加入正在进行的关闭。

disposer/reporter 的同步转换窗口不允许同一 Host 的变更重入。register/setFlag/setFlags 同步抛 HOST_TRANSITIONING；enable/disable 返回拒绝的 Promise。onError(name, error) 观察激活、释放和异常 thenable 失败；它自己的 throw/rejection 交给 utils 的共享宿主异常队列，不改变开关状态或覆盖业务错误。

Host 没有 dependsOn，也不强制串行所有 activate。若 A 必须先于 B 启用，应先 await enable(A)，或使用静态 Graph。把动态 import() 的调用放进 activate，加载才跟随许可后的激活；是否拆包由构建器决定，静态 import 的体积不会因开关消失。多租户应各建一个 Host 和开关快照。旧 enableResult、enableLegacyBoolean、disableNow 已移除；需要布尔值时比较 enable 结果的 status，物理清理则等待 disable。

sections.heading: 静态 Graph：登记、启动与读取

blocks.text: createCapabilityGraph(options?) 的 options 默认空对象，仅有可选 onError，缺省无用户诊断回调。它在创建 lifecycle 根 scope 前读取并验证回调，getter 或不可调用值为 GRAPH_INVALID_OPTION。

IGraphNodeId 是带品牌的字符串类型。`IGraphNodeDefinition<T>` 的必填字段为 id、kind、dependencies、start；id/kind 为非空字符串，dependencies 为数组，边必须含 provider 和 required: true。start(context) 返回或异步返回 { value, release }，release 必须可调用，value 可以合法地为 undefined。静态注册读取并保存字段与冻结边快照；重复节点/边分别拒绝。所有定义在首次 ready 前登记，ready 后 GRAPH_FROZEN；关闭接纳时 GRAPH_ADMISSION_CLOSED，终态 GRAPH_DISPOSED。
ready 先检查缺失 provider、自环与依赖环，再按 level、ordinal 分层调用 start。同层按登记序号发起，并行等待整层全部 settle，整层成功才进下一层。失败以该层规范顺序首个失败为 primary，其余失败保留于 errors 链，再回滚本层成功节点和此前已启动节点。启动失败不隐式重试，但仍可 dispose 收尾。

IGraphStartContext 提供 nodeId、原生 signal、get(provider)、own(resource, descriptor)。get 只允许已声明且 ready 的直接 provider，不取得 lease；启动上下文结束、作废或关闭后不能继续调用。own 将辅助资源交给 provisional scope，失败、取消、作废或关闭时回滚；descriptor 必须立即有可调用 force，错误为 GRAPH_INVALID_OPTION，原 lifecycle TypeError 经 cause 可达。不能把同一个 primary value 再作为辅助资源重复拥有。
primary value/release 只由 Graph 拥有一次，节点内先释放 primary 再释放 auxiliary，节点间逆拓扑释放。primary release(context) 收到结构化 signal、nodeId 和 report；清理失败走 Graph 的错误与诊断策略。

rows: 只在 open 时登记定义。
启动一次；重复调用保留同一 Promise，启动失败不自动 retry。
冻结的登记 id 数组，终态仍可查询。
冻结的时间点诊断，含 id、kind、state、value、error；未知 id 为 GRAPH_UNKNOWN_NODE。
直接读取同一原 payload，不创建诊断投影；仅整图 ready 时可见，其他时点为 undefined，未知 id 仍抛错。
校验 consumer 已声明该直接依赖且 provider ready；不等于任意节点查询。
整图状态与保留的 primary 错误。
先关闭接纳、取消启动，再逆拓扑释放；重复调用返回同一 Promise。

blocks.text: 整图状态为 open、starting、ready、failed、quiescing、terminal。节点状态为 registered、starting、ready、suspended、failed、blocked、rolled-back、released；静态入口不提供动态 suspend 方法。readValue 的 undefined 也可能是真实数据，需结合 graph.state 判断可用性；payload 保持原对象身份和可变性，旧诊断不随之变成新的状态快照。自写 ICapabilityGraph 实现必须包含 readValue。
同步生命周期回调重入同一 Graph 操作触发 GRAPH_REENTRANT_OPERATION。onError 观察 cleanup 和 late-result failure，不替换 primary；回调自身失败也交给共享宿主异常队列。Graph dispose 的失败可返回 GRAPH_DISPOSE_FAILED，和 Host 报告后继续完成的策略不同。
静态建图只读取一次节点和边，以迭代 DFS 和 ordinal/level 桶在线性 O(v + e + p) 成本内构造，p 为捕获输入大小。多闭环按根 ordinal 与声明依赖顺序报告遇到的首个闭环。动态增删保留原算法。

buildCapabilityTopology(nodes, onUnknownProvider, onCycle, onInvalid) 只计算，不调用 start 或 release。四个参数均必填。节点为 { id, dependencies, ordinal }；ordinal 必须是唯一安全整数，连续覆盖 [0, nodeCount)，不静默重排或重写坏输入。边的 provider 非空、required 为 boolean；缺席 required provider 交 onUnknownProvider(nodeId, provider)，存在的 optional 边也参与层级和环检测。

结果 ICapabilityTopology 深冻结，包含 ordered，以及只读 providers、consumers、indegree、level、ordinal 映射。顺序为 (level, ordinal)：先依赖层级，同层再登记顺序。providers 为提供者到消费者，consumers 为消费者到依赖；indegree 是接纳时的依赖数。ReadonlyMap/ReadonlySet facade 不提供 mutation；forEach(callback, thisArg?) 保留标准接收者语义。

onCycle(path) 与 onInvalid(reason, nodeId?, failure?) 由调用方决定抛出错误外壳。getter 失败的 failure 含精确 cause，即使 cause 为 undefined 也保留；纯拓扑 owner 将其留在 adapter 抛出错误的 cause/errors 链，不换掉可附加的原生错误身份。TopologyInvalidReason 的值为 invalid-node、duplicate-node、duplicate-edge、duplicate-ordinal、unknown-node、transaction-open、transaction-closed。

createTopologyIndex(adapter) 要求 onCycle 与 onInvalid，不创建服务。增量输入只有 id/dependencies，索引自己持有单调 registrationOrdinal；删除不重编号，setDependencies 不更换登记序号。snapshot().ordinal 则把当前节点压缩为连续序号，供静态投影使用。required 与当前存在的 optional 边参与层级与环检测，缺席 optional provider 被记录但不阻塞节点。

rows: 当前节点数与是否存在。
读取原单调登记序号，未知节点由 onInvalid 处理。
原子更新节点或边，保留缺席 provider 的悬空事实。
冻结的直接边，或按 required/optional 分类的直接消费者。
当前缺席 provider 的边。
包含 roots 的 required 消费者传递闭包，按规范顺序返回。
全部或给定子集的规范顺序；省略即全部，子集去重，未知 id 拒绝。
深冻结的静态拓扑投影。
隔离事务，提供同一套 reader/writer 和 commit/rollback。

blocks.text: 事务提交前基础读保持原快照，基础写和嵌套 begin 被拒绝。commit 发布工作副本，rollback 丢弃它并保留全部可观察事实；完成后的事务连读取都拒绝。静态拓扑与增量索引复用同一私有结构/边准入，不公开可信构建助手。

dependency 入口不启动、释放或修改索引。IDependencyStateReader 返回 activated、enabled、suspended、stale 四个独立 boolean：是否已激活、是否允许、是否挂起、保留绑定是否过期；没有一个合并的状态字符串。计划深冻结，含 steps（id/action）、order、edges（provider/consumer/optional/status?）和 blockedBy。

DependencyPolicy 为 reject、cascade、suspend；DependencyMutationKind 为 remove、disable。DependencyAction 为 release、disable、suspend、resume、rebind、restart、activate、invalidate。DependencyEdgeStatus.optionalAbsent 的值是 optional-absent，说明缺席的可选 provider。

rows: request 必含 roots、kind、policy；reject 报告阻塞者，cascade 生成消费者优先计划，suspend 只暂停已激活且未挂起的消费者。remove 的根动作为 release，disable 为 disable。
消费者优先重启闭包，跳过未激活节点；已挂起节点改为 invalidate。
request 含 target、canRebind；先安排直接 rebind，挂起消费者 invalidate，其余生成 restart 闭包。
request 含 provider、generationChanged、canRebind；只遍历挂起前沿，过期者 restart，仍缺 required provider 者继续阻塞。
仅规划尚未激活的 required 上游 provider，不把 roots 本身放进 activate steps。
选择批次内非 lazy 成员及其 required provider，返回规范顺序的只读 Set。
规划全部节点的逆规范释放顺序。
投影受影响集合的 required 内部边与相关 optional 边。

blocks.text: invalidate 表示现有挂起实例的绑定已过期，调用方保持挂起并置 stale；之后由 planResume 选择 restart。canRebind 是调用方的能力判断，不是规划器执行 rebind。执行、错误上报、世代、lease 和物理清理仍归组合 owner。非法 mutation kind/policy 触发 GRAPH_INVALID_OPTION。

sections.id: 动态-graph-与精确代际所有权
sections.heading: 动态 Graph 与精确代际所有权

blocks.text: createDynamicCapabilityGraph(options) 必须提供 startBatch(entries) 与 releaseBatch(entries, fence)，缺少任何一个都为 GRAPH_INVALID_OPTION。没有默认节点级执行宿主；组合 owner 决定怎样启动 definition.start、建立值与释放 instance。start entries 含 id、binding、冻结定义；release entries 含 id、binding、instance，均对应精确旧实例，按提供方优先的规范顺序交付；owner 等待 fence 后自行倒序执行物理释放。

可选 report 默认无用户回调；mutationAdmissionMs 默认 undefined，队列预算实际关闭，提供时必须为非负有限数；releaseBinding 默认不调用。普通 mutation 共用 FIFO，拒绝的前序任务不阻塞后来者。排队超过 admission 预算、尚未执行的任务以 GRAPH_MUTATION_ADMISSION_TIMEOUT 拒绝并保留 lifecycle 原错。最终 dispose 在同一 FIFO 等待已准入任务，但关闭自身 admission timeout，不强制中断前序工作。

register(node, binding?) 和 replace(node, binding?, options?) 在离开队列、开始执行时才读取 id/kind/start/dependencies，一次接纳为不可变定义与边快照。改原对象不改变身份、诊断或边；更改定义必须 replace。捕获的 start 保留原 definition 接收者与返回值，getter 失败为 GRAPH_INVALID_NODE，原错误或 cause 保留。binding 省略为 undefined；没有绑定时不能 acquireBinding。

rows: 允许 required/optional 边，登记后尝试启动受影响前沿；缺席 optional 不阻塞。
policy 默认 cascade；移除目标定义，释放受影响实例，仍保留的消费者因 removed 阻塞；reject 有 required 消费者时原子拒绝。
同样只接受 reject/cascade，默认 cascade；保留实例，不执行 release，依赖消费者被阻塞。
目标必须 suspended，否则 GRAPH_NODE_NOT_SUSPENDED；恢复满足全部 required provider 的前沿，已有实例不重新 start。
restartDependents 默认启用；false 时用 onReplaced 通知直接 required 消费者，缺少回调或回调失败则重启相应闭包；失败先 report。
返回 required/optional 两组直接消费者，未知 id 抛 GRAPH_UNKNOWN_NODE。
尝试启动当前 registered/blocked/failed 前沿，再将整图标记 ready，不冻结拓扑；仍可能保留 blocked 节点，不保证重复调用同一 Promise。
返回新的、未冻结的 id/kind/state/value/error/reason/binding/generation/ordinal/rank/level 诊断记录。
非 owning 读取，不检查节点可用性；未知 id 或缺席绑定返回 undefined，不能据此持有异步使用权。
仅 ready 且存在 binding 时返回冻结 { value, release }；release 幂等。
当前登记 id、整图状态与变更世代。
关闭接纳，按规范释放路径收尾并清空定义，重复调用同 Promise。

blocks.text: 动态 remove/suspend 不接受纯规划器的 suspend 策略。默认 cascade 不删除所有消费者定义，而是按影响关闭/阻塞它们。optional 边不触发 required 级联，dependentsOf 仍会报告这些直接关系。顺序始终按 level/ordinal，不采用不同层级之间仅按最小 ordinal 的旧顺序。

每个变更结果只有 affected、topologyChanged、generation，没有公开测试计数或计时字段。同边 replace 保留 ordinal/rank/level 的语义；改变边后重新计算诊断。GraphBlockedReason 的 missing、suspended、removed、failed 从 graph 入口导入；GraphBindingReleaseReason 的 remove、replace、dispose 从 dynamic 入口导入；readiness 的 ready/blocked/failed 使用根入口 GraphReadinessState。

异步工作要在 acquireBinding 后用 finally 调用 lease.release。remove/replace/dispose 先 seal 旧 generation，把同一个不会 reject 的 fence 交给 releaseBatch；所有精确旧 lease 归零后 fence 才 resolve。组合 owner 不得在 fence 前启动物理 disposer。新 generation 使用不同 lease key，晚到旧 release 不会替新绑定解锁；releaseBinding 在所属实例清理后按 remove/replace/dispose 原因交回 binding custody。

startBatch 单节点失败能归给该节点 failed；多节点批次无法归因时全部 blocked，reason 为 failed。nodeState.error 保留原始错误，GRAPH_START_FAILED 的 detail.nodes 列出整批节点。startBatch 部分启动成功后抛错时，Graph 不知道已创建的部分实例，组合 owner 必须回滚；静态 Graph 的整层回滚保证不能套用到这里。report 是最终观察口，自己的 throw/rejection 不改变 mutation 结果，交共享宿主异常队列。
snapshotGraphReadiness(source) 是桥接外部 readiness source 的低层工具。严格先读 state，再读 error，各一次；只接受 GraphReadinessState.ready/blocked/failed，返回冻结 { state, error }。普通代码读取 Graph 本身状态即可，不应把这三个可用性值当 Host 的五个生命周期状态。
原生且可附码的 getter Error 保持实例、类型和 stack，并附 INVALID_OPTION；primitive、不可变错误或冲突身份走 coded fallback，原值仍在 cause（包含抛出 undefined）。state 非法时立即拒绝，不继续读取 error。

Host 自有错误的 source 为 CAPABILITY_SOURCE，即 capability；Graph 自有错误为 CAPABILITY_GRAPH_SOURCE，即 capability.graph。用 (source, code) 区分归属。身份字段通过属性附加，不改写 stack；可附加的原生错误保留类型与实例，需包装时经 cause/errors 保留原对象。私有错误工厂不是公开入口。

Make feature flags govern the feature itself: when a flag turns off, the connections, timers and subscriptions the feature started are released, and features that depend on each other start, roll back and shut down in dependency order.

sections.heading: You may have run into this

items: The config center turned a feature off, but its connection and timers keep running. The flag was checked once, before startup, and nothing is responsible for closing what the feature created. Run the example
A new config arrives and you diff it against the old one by hand. Miss one entry and a feature that should be off stays running. Run the example
Two parts of a page turn on the same feature and open two connections. The first start had not finished, so the second caller could not see it and started again. Run the example
An admin turned a feature off, and a slow load switched it back on. When the asynchronous start returned, nothing checked whether the flag had changed. Run the example

Features depend on each other, but start and stop order is written by hand. A screen starts before the service it needs, or one step fails and the services started before it stay running. Run the example

blocks.text: The usual approach fetches a set of booleans from a config center or feature flag service and writes `if (flags.chat) startChat()` in code. The flag service tells you a value; it does not deal with the connections, timers and subscriptions a feature has already started once that value changes. This module turns each feature into a lifecycle owned by a host: the flag decides whether it may run, and the host starts it, stops it and cleans up after it.

items: Turning a flag off actually stops the feature. In the usual approach a flag going false only affects later checks, and a running feature keeps working. Here `setFlag(name, false)` takes the feature down immediately and calls its `dispose`, so the connection closes and the timer stops. Run the example

One new config replaces them all, and features left out are released. No diffing old and new configs yourself. `setFlags` atomically replaces every flag, treats any feature missing from the new config as off, and releases features in the reverse order they finished starting. Run the example

Turning a feature on twice starts it once. Checking "is there an instance already" misses the time while the first start is still running. Here concurrent `enable` calls share one start and one Promise. Run the example

A late start cannot bring a disabled feature back. If the flag is already off when an asynchronous start completes, the host discards the result and releases the resources it just created. Run the example

Dependencies decide the order of start, rollback and shutdown. Once dependencies between features are registered in a graph, a provider starts first and stops last; if one step fails to start, the parts already started roll back in reverse order. Start order, rollback on failure

A “provider” supplies a service and a “consumer” uses it. A “required” dependency must exist before startup. A “DAG” is a directed dependency graph without cycles. “Topological order” puts providers before consumers. These graphs own service resources rather than reactive computations.

blocks.text: The root entry @migaia/capability provides Capability Host, state constants, error identities and readiness snapshots. Four separate subpaths serve different purposes: @migaia/capability/graph owns static lifecycle graphs; @migaia/capability/graph/topology owns pure topology and incremental indexes; @migaia/capability/graph/dependency produces pure dependency plans; @migaia/capability/graph/dynamic coordinates runtime changes and binding custody. Import from these published entries rather than internal files.

The module uses @migaia/lifecycle for generations, ownership, draining and mutation queues, and @migaia/utils for errors and thenables. It has no reverse dependency on Store, UI, DOM, Node or platform adapters. The default static Graph requires native AbortController/AbortSignal support from its host; ESM support alone is insufficient.

“Host” here always means the in-process container created by createCapabilityHost. It holds definitions, shared context, flags and activation state, without reading provider-to-consumer edges. PluginHost owns plugin installation, pipelines and rollback. Storage Host groups storage backends. Worker, thread and process supervision owns isolation and physical termination. Those are separate responsibilities.

A capability graph expresses startup dependencies between services and resources. It is not a graph of reactive data computations. The static entry supports required providers only; optional availability notifications and cross-realm adapters are outside that entry. Runtime topology changes use the dynamic entry. This module publishes no cross-realm adapter, and a Promise timeout cannot terminate a synchronous loop in the same realm.

sections.heading: Creating a Host and capturing inputs

blocks.text: createCapabilityHost(context, options?) returns `ICapabilityHost<Context>`, with Context inferred from the argument. Every activate receives the same context reference. The Host does not freeze, inspect or modify it; include only the application objects capabilities actually need.

options defaults to an empty object and must be an object or function. Null and primitive values produce a TypeError carrying INVALID_OPTION. Creation captures options.flags and options.onError; later changes to the original options do not change the Host. Omitted flags deny every capability. Omitted onError supplies no user diagnostic callback; a supplied value must be callable. Failed option reads preserve their original cause under INVALID_OPTION. Method-style onError keeps the original options receiver.

Flags permit only own, enumerable data properties whose value is exactly true. Inherited properties grant nothing; getters are not evaluated. Names such as `__proto__` and constructor are ordinary internal Map keys. Editing the original flags has no effect: use setFlag or setFlags. Descriptor-read failures retain their exact cause.

ICapabilityHandle requires only dispose(): void or `PromiseLike<void>`. Each capability adds its own business methods; the Host does not wrap that object. `ICapabilityDefinition<Context, Handle>` requires name and activate(context), with Handle defaulting to ICapabilityHandle. A name must be a string that is nonblank after trimming. Duplicate names, invalid names and non-callable activate values produce ALREADY_REGISTERED, INVALID_NAME and INVALID_ACTIVATE respectively.

Registration captures and freezes name/activate. Mutating the original definition cannot rewrite the admitted identity; method-style activate can read this.name from its frozen receiver. On adoption the Host also captures handle.dispose, so later property changes cannot replace cleanup ownership. A missing/non-callable disposer or a failing disposer getter produces an INVALID_HANDLE TypeError and a failed activation.

rows: Registers synchronously without activating; rejects terminal or reentrant mutations.
Returns a fresh array of registered names on each read.
Returns lifecycle state; unknown names throw NOT_REGISTERED.
Returns the exact business handle returned by activate, or undefined when inactive; unknown names throw NOT_REGISTERED.
Reads the current generation’s latest activation/cleanup failure; successful restart or reconfiguration clears it.
Only strict true permits activation. False synchronously invalidates pending work, removes the handle and begins cleanup; true does not activate.
Atomically replaces the entire allowlist; omitted names are denied. Unreadable input first denies everything, then throws INVALID_OPTION.
Returns a structured outcome. Concurrent calls share one activation and its pending Promise; an on capability is not activated again, and a denied capability never calls activate.
Waits for this capability’s pending activation and cleanup to drain. Returns true only if it was on; cancelling an activating capability still waits for cleanup but returns false.
Closes permanently, releases in reverse actual activation-completion order and drains all pending work.
Becomes true when terminal cleanup begins. Read-only diagnostics remain available; mutations cannot revive this Host.

blocks.text: There are no additional hidden options. state/handle/error require registered names. setFlag can configure a name before it is registered. Invalid enable/disable operations return rejected Promises. disable checks HOST_DISPOSED before looking up the name. Admission failures from register/setFlag/setFlags throw synchronously.

CapabilityState and ICapabilityState have five values: off (allowed but inactive), gated (denied), activating (activation in flight), on (valid handle adopted) and failed (activation failed). A cleanup failure is recorded and reported while state remains off/gated; it does not change those states to failed. Host gated and Graph blocked have different meanings.

CapabilityEnableStatus contains enabled, gated, cancelled and failed. Only the failed branch of ICapabilityEnableResult carries error. ICapabilityEnableStatusValue is the union of those status values. Enabled means the result was adopted. Initial denial, or a late result arriving while the flag is still denied, yields gated. Invalidation by disable, dispose or another generation yields cancelled. A current activation failure or invalid handle yields failed, with the same error available through error(name).

Invalidation advances a lifecycle generation. A late activate result is adopted only if its original generation is still current; otherwise the new handle is immediately released rather than reopening a disabled feature. Old-generation cleanup failures are reported without poisoning a healthy replacement. Applicable current-generation cleanup failures, including cleanup with no replacement, remain available through error(name).

Both bulk setFlags rollback and dispose release in reverse actual activation-completion order, rather than registration or enable-call order. One cleanup failure does not prevent the remaining handles from closing. The Host records and reports cleanup failures without introducing an aggregate rejection policy. disable drains one capability; dispose drains all of them, including cleanup created by late activations during the wait. Activation or cleanup that never settles keeps the relevant drain pending.

The first dispose returns the sole completion Promise. Further calls before it settles fail with HOST_TRANSITIONING. A synchronous disposer reentry throws synchronously; a later reentry returns a rejected Promise. Only after completion do repeated calls return that original canonical Promise. Retain and await the first result instead of calling dispose again to join work in progress.

Mutations cannot reenter the same Host during synchronous disposer/reporter transition windows. register/setFlag/setFlags throw HOST_TRANSITIONING; enable/disable return rejected Promises. onError(name, error) observes activation, cleanup and abnormal-thenable failures. Its own throw/rejection goes to the shared utils host-error queue without changing gate state or replacing the business failure.

The Host has no dependsOn declarations and does not serialize every activation. Explicitly await enable(A) before enable(B), or use static Graph, when B needs A. Place the dynamic import() call inside activate so loading follows permitted activation. The bundler decides code splitting; flags do not remove static imports. Create a separate Host and flag snapshot per tenant. Removed APIs enableResult, enableLegacyBoolean and disableNow are unavailable; compare the structured enable status for a boolean and await disable for physical cleanup.

sections.heading: Static Graph: registration, startup and reads

blocks.text: createCapabilityGraph(options?) defaults options to an empty object with only optional onError; omission supplies no user diagnostic callback. It reads and validates the callback before creating a lifecycle root scope. Failing getters and non-callable values produce GRAPH_INVALID_OPTION.

IGraphNodeId is a branded string. `IGraphNodeDefinition<T>` requires id, kind, dependencies and start. IDs and kinds are nonempty strings. dependencies is an array of edges requiring provider and required: true. start(context) returns or resolves to { value, release }, where release is callable and undefined is a valid value. Static registration captures fields and frozen edge facts; duplicate nodes and edges are rejected. Register all nodes before the first ready. Later registration produces GRAPH_FROZEN; closed admission produces GRAPH_ADMISSION_CLOSED, and terminal mutation produces GRAPH_DISPOSED.

ready checks missing providers, self-loops and cycles, then starts nodes in level/ordinal layers. Calls within a layer begin in registration order and settle in parallel; the next layer starts only after the entire previous layer succeeds. On failure, the first failure in canonical layer order is primary, with others retained through errors. Successful peers and earlier layers are rolled back. A failed startup does not retry implicitly, but dispose remains available.

IGraphStartContext supplies nodeId, a native signal, get(provider) and own(resource, descriptor). get reads only a declared, ready direct provider and acquires no lease. Context calls stop being valid after startup ends, invalidation or closing. own places auxiliary resources in a provisional scope for rollback on failure, abort, stale completion or disposal. The descriptor must immediately supply a callable force; invalid ownership produces GRAPH_INVALID_OPTION with the lifecycle TypeError reachable through cause. Do not register the primary value a second time as auxiliary ownership.

Graph owns each primary value/release exactly once. Within a node, primary cleanup precedes auxiliary cleanup; across nodes, cleanup follows reverse topology. The primary release(context) receives a structural signal, nodeId and report callback. Cleanup failures follow Graph’s error and diagnostic policy.

rows: Starts once and preserves Promise identity across repeated calls; failed startup does not automatically retry.
Frozen registration-ID array, still readable after termination.
Frozen point-in-time diagnostic containing id, kind, state, value and error. Unknown IDs produce GRAPH_UNKNOWN_NODE.
Reads the same original payload without constructing a diagnostic projection. Visible only when the entire graph is ready; otherwise undefined. Unknown IDs still throw.
Checks that consumer declared this direct dependency and provider is ready; it is not an arbitrary node lookup.

Closes admission, cancels startup and releases in reverse topology; repeated calls share one Promise.

blocks.text: Overall states are open, starting, ready, failed, quiescing and terminal. Node states are registered, starting, ready, suspended, failed, blocked, rolled-back and released; the static entry offers no dynamic suspend method. readValue can return a legitimate undefined payload, so inspect graph.state for availability. Payloads retain their object identity and mutability; old diagnostics remain state snapshots. Custom ICapabilityGraph implementations must include readValue.

Synchronous lifecycle callbacks that reenter the same Graph operation produce GRAPH_REENTRANT_OPERATION. onError observes cleanup and late-result failures without replacing the primary error; callback failures also reach the shared host-error queue. Graph disposal can reject with GRAPH_DISPOSE_FAILED, unlike the Host’s report-and-complete cleanup policy.

Static construction reads each node and edge once, then uses iterative DFS and ordinal/level buckets in O(v + e + p), where p is the captured input size. Multiple cycles report the first closed path reached by root ordinal and declared provider order. Incremental edits retain their existing algorithm.

buildCapabilityTopology(nodes, onUnknownProvider, onCycle, onInvalid) computes a plan without calling start or release. All four arguments are required. Nodes contain id, dependencies and ordinal. Ordinals must be unique safe integers covering [0, nodeCount) without gaps. Invalid input is not silently sorted or rewritten. Edges require a nonempty provider and boolean required. Missing required providers go to onUnknownProvider(nodeId, provider); present optional edges also affect levels and cycle checks.

The deeply frozen ICapabilityTopology contains ordered plus read-only providers, consumers, indegree, level and ordinal maps. Scheduling is by (level, ordinal): dependency depth first, registration order within a level. providers maps providers to consumers, while consumers maps consumers to their dependencies. indegree captures admission-time dependency counts. ReadonlyMap/ReadonlySet facades expose no mutation, and forEach(callback, thisArg?) follows the standard receiver semantics.

onCycle(path) and onInvalid(reason, nodeId?, failure?) let callers choose their error shell. A getter failure supplies the exact cause, even when it is undefined. Pure topology retains that cause in the adapter-thrown error’s cause/errors chain, preserving native identity where it can be annotated. TopologyInvalidReason values are invalid-node, duplicate-node, duplicate-edge, duplicate-ordinal, unknown-node, transaction-open and transaction-closed.

createTopologyIndex(adapter) requires onCycle and onInvalid without creating services. Incremental node inputs contain only id/dependencies. The index owns a monotonic registrationOrdinal that removals never renumber; setDependencies retains it. snapshot().ordinal instead compresses current nodes into a dense static projection. Required and currently present optional edges affect levels/cycles; absent optional providers are recorded without blocking nodes.

rows: Reads the original monotonic registration position; unknown nodes use onInvalid.
Atomically update nodes/edges, retaining dangling incoming provider facts.
Frozen direct edges, or direct consumers split into required/optional arrays.
Edges whose providers are currently absent.
Roots and their transitive required consumers in canonical order.
Canonical order for all nodes or a supplied deduplicated subset; omission selects all, unknown IDs fail.

blocks.text: Base readers retain the original snapshot until commit; base writes and nested begin calls are rejected. Commit publishes the working view, while rollback discards it and preserves observable facts. Settled transactions reject reads as well as writes. Static topology and indexes share one private structural/edge admission owner; static construction does not replay incremental edits.

The dependency entry neither starts nor releases nodes and never mutates the index. IDependencyStateReader returns four independent booleans: activated, enabled, suspended and stale. They describe whether a node has activated, is permitted, is suspended and retains an outdated binding; there is no combined state string. Plans are deeply frozen and contain steps (id/action), order, edges (provider/consumer/optional/status?) and blockedBy.

DependencyPolicy contains reject, cascade and suspend. DependencyMutationKind contains remove and disable. DependencyAction contains release, disable, suspend, resume, rebind, restart, activate and invalidate. DependencyEdgeStatus.optionalAbsent is optional-absent, identifying an absent optional provider.

rows: Requires roots, kind and policy. Reject reports blockers; cascade produces consumer-first steps; suspend pauses only activated, not-yet-suspended consumers. Root actions are release for remove and disable for disable.
Consumer-first restart closure, skipping inactive nodes and invalidating suspended nodes.
Requires target and canRebind. Plans direct rebinds, invalidates suspended consumers and restarts the remaining closures.
Requires provider, generationChanged and canRebind. Traverses only the suspended frontier; stale nodes restart and nodes missing required providers remain blocked.
Plans only inactive required upstream providers; the requested roots themselves are absent from activate steps.
Selects non-lazy batch members and their required providers, returning a canonically ordered read-only Set.
Plans every node in reverse canonical release order.
Projects internal required edges and relevant optional relationships for the affected set.

blocks.text: Invalidate marks a retained suspended instance’s provider binding as stale. The caller keeps it suspended and sets stale; planResume later selects restart. canRebind is a caller-owned capability decision, not an executed rebind. Execution, reporting, generations, leases and physical cleanup remain with the composition owner. Invalid mutation kinds/policies produce GRAPH_INVALID_OPTION.

createDynamicCapabilityGraph(options) requires both startBatch(entries) and releaseBatch(entries, fence); either missing callback produces GRAPH_INVALID_OPTION. There is no default node-level execution host. A composition owner decides how to invoke definition.start, establish values and release instances. Startup entries contain id, binding and the frozen definition. Release entries contain id, binding and instance for the exact outgoing instance, supplied in canonical provider-first order. The owner awaits the fence and performs physical releases in reverse order.

Optional report supplies no user callback by default. mutationAdmissionMs defaults to undefined, effectively disabling the queue budget; a provided budget must be finite and nonnegative. releaseBinding is not called when omitted. Ordinary mutations share a FIFO, and a rejected predecessor does not stop later work. A mutation that has not begun before its queue budget expires rejects with GRAPH_MUTATION_ADMISSION_TIMEOUT, retaining the lifecycle error. Final dispose waits behind admitted work in the same FIFO with its own admission timeout disabled, without forcibly interrupting predecessors.

register(node, binding?) and replace(node, binding?, options?) read id/kind/start/dependencies once when execution begins after queuing. They admit immutable definition/edge snapshots. Editing the caller’s object cannot change identity, diagnostics or edges; use replace explicitly. The captured start keeps its original definition receiver and return value. Getter failures produce GRAPH_INVALID_NODE while retaining the native error or cause. An omitted binding remains undefined and cannot be acquired.

rows: Accepts required/optional edges and attempts startup of the affected frontier; absent optional providers do not block.
Policy defaults to cascade. Removes the target definition, releases affected instances and leaves retained consumers blocked with removed. Reject atomically refuses targets with required consumers.
Accepts only reject/cascade, defaulting to cascade. Retains instances without release and blocks dependent consumers.
Requires a suspended target or produces GRAPH_NODE_NOT_SUSPENDED. Recovers the frontier whose required providers are all available; existing instances are not started again.
Restarts dependents by default. With restartDependents false, onReplaced notifies direct required consumers; missing or failing callbacks restart the relevant closures after reporting failure.
Direct required/optional consumers; unknown IDs throw GRAPH_UNKNOWN_NODE.
Attempts the registered/blocked/failed frontier and marks the graph ready without freezing topology; blocked nodes can remain, and repeated calls do not promise the same Promise.
Non-owning read without availability checks; unknown IDs or absent bindings return undefined, granting no asynchronous use right.
Requires a ready node with a binding. Returns frozen { value, release }; release is idempotent.
Registered IDs, overall state and mutation generation.
Closes admission, completes canonical cleanup and clears definitions; repeated calls share one Promise.

blocks.text: Dynamic remove/suspend do not accept the pure planner’s suspend policy. Default cascade does not delete every consumer definition: it closes or blocks affected instances. Optional edges do not trigger required cascades, but dependentsOf still reports their direct relationships. Ordering always uses level/ordinal rather than the older minimum-ordinal ordering across different levels.

Mutation results contain only affected, topologyChanged and generation; public test counters and timing fields are gone. Same-edge replacement preserves ordinal/rank/level semantics, while edge changes rebuild diagnostics. Import GraphBlockedReason (missing/suspended/removed/failed) from graph, GraphBindingReleaseReason (remove/replace/dispose) from dynamic, and readiness values ready/blocked/failed from root GraphReadinessState.

Async users acquireBinding and release their lease in finally. Remove/replace/dispose first seal the old generation and pass one non-rejecting fence to releaseBatch. The fence resolves only when every exact old-generation lease reaches zero. The composition owner must not begin physical disposal before that fence. New generations use different lease keys, so a late old release cannot unlock a new binding. releaseBinding returns binding custody after its instance cleanup, with the remove/replace/dispose reason.

A single-node startBatch failure marks that node failed. A larger failed batch cannot identify one culprit, so all members become blocked with reason failed. nodeState.error retains the original error; GRAPH_START_FAILED detail.nodes lists the batch. If startBatch throws after partially starting resources, Graph has not received those partial instances, so the composition owner must roll them back. Static Graph’s layer-rollback guarantee does not apply here. report is a final observer: its own throws/rejections go to the shared host-error queue without changing the mutation result.

snapshotGraphReadiness(source) is a low-level admission tool for external readiness sources. It reads state before error, once each, accepts only GraphReadinessState.ready/blocked/failed and returns frozen { state, error }. Ordinary consumers can read Graph’s own state. These availability values are separate from the Host’s five lifecycle states.

Annotatable native getter Errors retain identity, type and stack while receiving INVALID_OPTION. Primitive throws, immutable errors and conflicting identities use a coded fallback whose cause retains the original value, including undefined. An invalid state fails before reading error.

Host-owned errors use CAPABILITY_SOURCE, capability. Graph-owned errors use CAPABILITY_GRAPH_SOURCE, capability.graph. Branch on (source, code). Identity fields are attached without rewriting stack. Annotatable native errors preserve their type and object identity; wrappers retain originals through cause/errors. Private error factories are not public entry points.

blocks.text: To compose persistence or another optional feature, create context containing the required application objects; register a capability that awaits import inside activate; await enable and read the business handle only after enabled; await disable on page exit; and await the first dispose on application shutdown. Reporting observes rather than controlling lifecycle. Give each tenant its own container and flags.

When enable yields gated, check whether only the original flags were edited, whether values are strict true and whether setFlag was missed. setFlags({}) revokes everything; use setFlag for one change. If a disabled feature returns, check for direct activate calls outside the Host or reentry from cleanup. Use Graph for service dependency order rather than asking Host to infer it.

Available module scripts are fmt, lint, typecheck, typecheck:test and test, with build for compilation. The existing bench:resume measures planner behavior, but this guide makes no unverified performance claim from it.

Choose a scenario for the problem at hand, then consult the boundaries between Host, Graph and pure planning tools. All six examples use published entries without external services or another execution host.

Release a late handle after permission is withdrawn
Stop a running feature when its flag is turned off

Roll back a provider when its consumer fails to start

blocks.text: A feature is downloaded or starts work even though the current tenant has not enabled it.
A boolean checked only at registration time does not own the later activation or its cleanup. Turning the boolean on can also accidentally start work before the application requests it.

Create one capability host, which owns activation state and disposable handles, and register an activation callback. Missing flags deny activation; call `setFlag(name, true)` to grant permission and then `enable(name)` to start. Finish with `dispose()`.

The context field tenant: demo is shared application data passed unchanged to activate. Omitted options deny all flags and supply no onError callback. Registration names the export capability and supplies activate returning a disposable handle. setFlag true only grants permission; enable starts the work.
Output:

blocks.code:
first attempt: gated
after permission: off
activated: demo
activation: enabled
released: export

blocks.text: Prints `first attempt: gated`, `after permission: off`, `activated: demo`, `activation: enabled`, then `released: export`.

The denied attempt does not call the activation callback, and granting permission alone leaves the capability off. The host cannot undo a static import: place a dynamic import inside `activate` when code loading must also wait for permission.

sections.heading: Share one activation while two callers wait

blocks.text: Two parts of a page enable the same feature together, creating duplicate connections or workers before either activation finishes.
Checking only whether a handle already exists misses the interval while the first activation is pending. Both callers see no handle and independently start the same work.

Call `enable(name)` on the same host. It publishes the in-flight Promise before invoking the activation callback, so another call while activation is pending joins that Promise and receives the same classified result.

Context is undefined, options.flags.search is true, and onError is omitted. The async activate returns a disposable handle. Registration and both enable calls use search. The shared-Promise guarantee applies to a pending activation on the same Host.
Output:

blocks.code:
same Promise: true
results: enabled,enabled
activations: 1

blocks.text: Prints `same Promise: true`, `results: enabled,enabled`, then `activations: 1`.

Concurrent callers share one pending activation rather than merely receiving equal statuses. Calls made after the capability is already enabled need not return that same Promise; separate host instances do not share activation state.

sections.heading: Release a late handle after permission is withdrawn

blocks.text: An administrator turns a feature off while its async activation is pending, but the feature becomes active again when the old request finishes.

A handwritten flag check before the first await only authorizes the beginning of the work. Assigning the returned handle unconditionally lets a stale completion restore a capability whose permission has already been revoked.

Withdraw permission with `setFlag(name, false)`. The host immediately invalidates that activation; if its handle arrives later, the host releases it instead of adopting it. Await `dispose()` when all activation and cleanup work must be drained.

flags.export starts true. activate returns the manually completed Promise in this example; setFlag false revokes permission and finish supplies a disposable handle. The final denial yields gated. Invalidation through disable while permission remains granted would yield cancelled instead.
Output:

blocks.code:
released late handle
activation: gated
state: gated
adopted handle: false

blocks.text: Prints `released late handle`, `activation: gated`, `state: gated`, then `adopted handle: false`.

With permission still withdrawn, the old result cannot become the active handle. The host does not forcibly interrupt user activation code; it owns the returned handle when that work finishes. Async release can continue after a flag update, so await `disable()` or `dispose()` to drain it.

sections.heading: Stop a running feature when its flag is turned off

blocks.text: A live chat feature has opened a connection for the current tenant and sends a heartbeat every second. An operator turns it off in the config center.

The usual approach fetches a set of booleans from a config center or feature flag service and writes `if (flags.liveChat) startChat()` in code. The flag service tells you a value; it does not deal with what happens when the value changes. The check runs once, before startup, so after the flag goes off the connection and timer already created keep running, unless every feature listens for flag changes and finds and closes its own resources.

In a host, the handle a feature returns when it starts is owned by the host. `setFlag(name, false)` takes that handle down synchronously and calls its `dispose`, so the feature actually stops; `disable(name)` waits for the release to finish.

The context's tenant is acme and is passed to activate unchanged. options.flags.liveChat starts as true. activate opens the connection and starts a heartbeat timer, and the handle it returns stops the timer and disconnects.
Output:

blocks.code:
chat connected: acme
activation: enabled
chat disconnected
state: gated handle: undefined
release finished

blocks.text: Prints `chat connected: acme`, `activation: enabled`, `chat disconnected`, `state: gated handle: undefined`, then `release finished`. Turning the flag off already ran the handle's `dispose`, so the timer stops and the process exits normally with no heartbeat left behind.

Turning a flag off only stops the feature; turning it back on does not start it again, so call `enable(name)` once more. When `dispose` is asynchronous the release continues in the background; wait for `disable(name)` or `dispose()` when you need to know the resources are gone.

sections.heading: Replace every flag with a new config and release features it leaves out

blocks.text: After startup the app has enabled search, chat and export. The config center pushes a new config: search stays on, chat is turned off, and export is not in the new config at all.

The usual approach compares the new config with the old one entry by entry, works out which features were turned off or removed, and calls each one's stop function. Miss one and it keeps running. Features are usually stopped in the order the code lists them, so a feature that started later, and may depend on earlier ones, can be left running or closed after the features it relies on.

`setFlags(flags)` atomically replaces every flag with one new config. Any name missing from the new config counts as off, and the features that are turned off are released in the reverse order they finished starting.
options.flags initially allows all three features, which start in the order search, chat, export. The new config lists only search: true and chat: false; export is left out.
Output:

blocks.code:
start search
start chat
start export
stop export
stop chat
search=on export=gated chat=gated
stop search

blocks.text: Prints the three starts, then `stop export`, `stop chat`, `search=on export=gated chat=gated`, and finally `stop search` from `dispose()`. Export, absent from the new config, is released just like chat, which was turned off explicitly, and the release order is the reverse of the order in which they finished starting.

A new config replaces the old one; it is not merged, so every feature you want to keep must be in it. Replacing only turns features off and releases them; a newly allowed feature still starts only when you call `enable(name)`. Give each tenant its own host with its own flag snapshot.

sections.heading: Start providers first and release consumers first

blocks.text: A screen starts before its configuration service is ready, or cleanup closes the configuration while the screen still uses it.

Running startup callbacks in registration order makes correctness depend on which module registers first. Reversing whichever async callbacks happened to finish first does not reliably reverse dependency order.

Register a static capability graph with explicit required provider edges, then await `ready()`. Each start callback can read its declared ready providers through `context.get()`. The graph owns the returned instances and releases them in reverse topology when disposed.

Both nodes supply id, kind, dependencies and start. Although the screen registers first, its required: true edge explicitly names config; config has no dependencies. Start returns value/release, and the screen reads theme from its direct provider through context.get. Omitted options supply no onError callback.
Output:

blocks.code:
start config
start screen: dark
state: ready
release screen
release config

blocks.text: Prints `start config`, `start screen: dark`, `state: ready`, `release screen`, then `release config`.

Although the consumer was registered first, its provider starts first and is released last. This is a resource dependency graph, not a reactive data graph. Registration freezes at the first `ready()`; use the dynamic graph entry when definitions must change after startup.

sections.heading: Roll back a provider when its consumer fails to start

blocks.text: A service starts successfully but its dependent screen fails, leaving the service running even though the feature never became ready.

A handwritten sequence that simply awaits each start stops at the thrown error. Previously created resources remain live unless every failure path manually releases them without losing the primary error.
Await `ready()` on the graph and catch its failure. The graph settles the active startup level, rolls back resources it already owns and retains the original startup failure for diagnostics.

The consumer’s required: true edge still targets config. Its start throws the pre-created primary error to demonstrate startup failure. Graph owns the provider’s returned value/release and rolls it back before ready rejects. No second resource owner is introduced for the failure path.
Output:

blocks.code:
rolled back config
original failure: true
code: GRAPH_START_FAILED
provider: rolled-back
graph: failed

blocks.text: Prints `rolled back config`, `original failure: true`, `code: GRAPH_START_FAILED`, `provider: rolled-back`, then `graph: failed`.

The provider is released before readiness rejects. This ordinary extensible Error retains its identity when tagged; foreign-source or non-extensible errors may instead be wrapped with the original on the cause chain. A failed static graph does not retry implicitly.

sections.heading: Inspect startup order before acquiring resources

blocks.text: A configuration editor needs to preview provider order and dependency depth before it starts any service.
Sorting only by registration order can place a consumer first. Reusing a running graph just to inspect its order would also mix validation and planning with resource startup.

Pass node IDs, dependency edges and dense registration ordinals to `buildCapabilityTopology()`, together with the three caller-owned failure callbacks. It returns a frozen topology snapshot: the planned order and levels, without invoking resource startup or release.

Each node ID is nonempty and ordinals uniquely cover 0, 1 and 2. The screen edge names config with required true; other dependency arrays are empty. Three required callbacks receive a missing provider, a cycle path or structural failure respectively. This valid-input example shares one reject callback that throws a pre-created error; it is never called on the successful path.
Output:

blocks.code:
input: screen,config,health
order: config,health,screen
levels: 0 0 1
frozen: true

blocks.text: Prints `input: screen,config,health`, `order: config,health,screen`, `levels: 0 0 1`, then `frozen: true`.

The plan puts providers before consumers and uses registration ordinals within a level without changing the input array. Ordinals must uniquely cover 0 through nodeCount minus one. This API plans only; use `createCapabilityGraph()` to own resource startup and release.

The root entry @migaia/capability provides Capability Host, state constants, error identities and readiness snapshots. Four separate subpaths serve different purposes: @migaia/capability/graph owns static lifecycle graphs; @migaia/capability/graph/topology owns pure topology and incremental indexes; @migaia/capability/graph/dependency produces pure dependency plans; @migaia/capability/graph/dynamic coordinates runtime changes and binding custody. Import from these published entries rather than internal files.

The module uses @migaia/lifecycle for generations, ownership, draining and mutation queues, and @migaia/utils for errors and thenables. It has no reverse dependency on Store, UI, DOM, Node or platform adapters. The default static Graph requires native AbortController/AbortSignal support from its host; ESM support alone is insufficient.

“Host” here always means the in-process container created by createCapabilityHost. It holds definitions, shared context, flags and activation state, without reading provider-to-consumer edges. PluginHost owns plugin installation, pipelines and rollback. Storage Host groups storage backends. Worker, thread and process supervision owns isolation and physical termination. Those are separate responsibilities.

A capability graph expresses startup dependencies between services and resources. It is not a graph of reactive data computations. The static entry supports required providers only; optional availability notifications and cross-realm adapters are outside that entry. Runtime topology changes use the dynamic entry. This module publishes no cross-realm adapter, and a Promise timeout cannot terminate a synchronous loop in the same realm.

sections.heading: Creating a Host and capturing inputs

blocks.text: createCapabilityHost(context, options?) returns `ICapabilityHost<Context>`, with Context inferred from the argument. Every activate receives the same context reference. The Host does not freeze, inspect or modify it; include only the application objects capabilities actually need.

options defaults to an empty object and must be an object or function. Null and primitive values produce a TypeError carrying INVALID_OPTION. Creation captures options.flags and options.onError; later changes to the original options do not change the Host. Omitted flags deny every capability. Omitted onError supplies no user diagnostic callback; a supplied value must be callable. Failed option reads preserve their original cause under INVALID_OPTION. Method-style onError keeps the original options receiver.

Flags permit only own, enumerable data properties whose value is exactly true. Inherited properties grant nothing; getters are not evaluated. Names such as `__proto__` and constructor are ordinary internal Map keys. Editing the original flags has no effect: use setFlag or setFlags. Descriptor-read failures retain their exact cause.

ICapabilityHandle requires only dispose(): void or `PromiseLike<void>`. Each capability adds its own business methods; the Host does not wrap that object. `ICapabilityDefinition<Context, Handle>` requires name and activate(context), with Handle defaulting to ICapabilityHandle. A name must be a string that is nonblank after trimming. Duplicate names, invalid names and non-callable activate values produce ALREADY_REGISTERED, INVALID_NAME and INVALID_ACTIVATE respectively.

Registration captures and freezes name/activate. Mutating the original definition cannot rewrite the admitted identity; method-style activate can read this.name from its frozen receiver. On adoption the Host also captures handle.dispose, so later property changes cannot replace cleanup ownership. A missing/non-callable disposer or a failing disposer getter produces an INVALID_HANDLE TypeError and a failed activation.

Returns a fresh array of registered names on each read.
Returns lifecycle state; unknown names throw NOT_REGISTERED.
Returns the exact business handle returned by activate, or undefined when inactive; unknown names throw NOT_REGISTERED.
Reads the current generation’s latest activation/cleanup failure; successful restart or reconfiguration clears it.
Only strict true permits activation. False synchronously invalidates pending work, removes the handle and begins cleanup; true does not activate.
Atomically replaces the entire allowlist; omitted names are denied. Unreadable input first denies everything, then throws INVALID_OPTION.
Returns a structured outcome. Concurrent calls share one activation and its pending Promise; an on capability is not activated again, and a denied capability never calls activate.
Waits for this capability’s pending activation and cleanup to drain. Returns true only if it was on; cancelling an activating capability still waits for cleanup but returns false.
